_comment: Homage fan game. Not an official Marvel, Sony or Insomniac game; no affiliation. Time-of-day presets for Scripts/build_look.py (piece P4). Units: sun/moon illuminance in lux, angles in degrees, distances in cm (UE) unless a key says km. sun.az = compass azimuth of the sun, clockwise from north, east = 90 (browser city: north = -Y in UE). Any key of post.* is a PostProcessSettings property (snake_case) and gets its override flag set.

midday.desc: round 03 v2: overcast late morning (LOOK-SPEC L2): neutral grey Rayleigh sky, bright hazy horizon, soft strong sun behind the cloud deck, average-metered exposure, highlights compressed

golden.desc: round 03 v2: golden hour 9 deg sun behind the avenue ends, warm Mie haze (far shore takes the sky tint), cool sky-fill in the shadows, highlights compressed

night.desc: round 03 v2: night with dark facade masses, neutral B-R, wide sodium / LED lamp pools, denser far haze

lights._comment: street lighting of the night rig (Scripts/build_look.py step 'night' -> /Game/Look/Look_NightLights). cd = candela, radius / distances in cm, angles in degrees. Lamp positions come from layout.json instances.lamp (the browser's own lamps).

screens._comment: coloured light in front of each Times-Square-like LED screen (quad positions from look_ts_screens.json = tools/perf_ue/extract_ts_screens.py). The screens' own ad content is IP-excluded from the port, so their emission is black; this restores the district's colour spill.

night.fills_desc: unshadowed low horizon 'city glow' directional fills (light pollution glow at the horizon from every side): they light the facades (cos of the incidence) but the streets only by sin(8 deg), so road pools stay distinct
night._r05: far band (L10): fog from 800 m at density .08 / max opacity .98 veils the lit far shore; cutoff 7 km keeps the sky clear of height fog so the far band sits under it (sweep G gN2: far-sky -21.5, dBR -2.6, S4 points 3.09 %, median 34.2)

tod.desc: round 05: ONE map, continuous time of day (wh.TimeOfDay 0-24, game clock = local daylight time). Keys are presets (or derived bases) at hours; the C++ driver AWHLookTimeOfDay interpolates every param (cyclic Catmull-Rom, clamped to the neighbouring keys) and moves the sun and moon on fixed declination circles (lat 40.7 N, Manhattan grid 29 deg east of true north). Expanded by Scripts/look_tod.py; weather (wh.Weather, 0 clear .. 1 overcast) blends daylight params toward 'overcast'.

sun.desc: early April / early September: golden sun at 9 deg / grid azimuth 238 at 18:24 (the round-03 golden pose), sunset 19:12, solar noon 13:00 at 53 deg

moon.desc: near-full moon: rises with the sunset, 38 deg / grid azimuth 118 at 22:00 (the round-03 night pose), sets after dawn

tod._r05_late: round 05 sweeps E/F/G: golden white temp 7800 -> 6400 + saturation (B-R into L6), clear day exposure -0.3 -> -0.8 (L4), blue-hour sun 30000 -> 5000 lux (the twilight glow at -6.7 deg lit the city through the sky light: sweep G gBsun0), night far-band fog with a 7 km cutoff (stepped, C++)
